text: Carrera is one of Safilo Group's home brands. Multibrands Italy B.V., a subsidiary of HAL Holding N.V., is the reference shareholder of Safilo Group S.p.A., with 49.8% of the share capital since January 2019.
short: Carrera is a Safilo brand; HAL Holding's Multibrands Italy holds 49.8% of Safilo.

source.name: Safilo Group: Shareholding
source.quote: Multibrands Italy B.V.'s stake in the share capital of Safilo increased to 49.8%

additionalSources.name: Safilo Group: Press Release - Publication of the new Articles of Association

additionalSources.quote: Safilo Group’s portfolio encompasses home brands - Carrera, Polaroid, Smith, SPY+, Serengeti, Blenders, Privé Revaux and Seventh Street.
